title: WORTHY MEETING
author: Neha Bhandarkar
text:
Please give me
a fistful of clouds as a gift
I`ll keep them safely
in a chest

Please give me
two meters of fog
So I can cover up myself
before the sun rises too high

Please also give me
some raindrops too
So I can use them
to embellish my braids

I`ll like to adorn myself
With the notes of Sargam and
the melodies of a cuckoo
I`ll like to dance with
a striking lightning

I`ll fasten a waterfall`s
burble to my ankles
I`ll play `Holi` borrowing
colours from the rainbow
I`ll be friend with
the first few rays of the Sun

I`ll beg you a thousand times
throughout all the seasons
to accept all of my
incomparable emotions.

Every year I`ll send you
Some of my time in an envelope
But you have to visit me once
This is my only condition
You`ll come to visit me, nah?

Listen, O` Dear!
I`ll like to dedicate to you
the sweet lunar smile
for a worthy meeting
of yours and mine!
